title: A notebook for Peru
subtitle: Our route, little discoveries, and room to change our minds.
label: Starting plan

items.vibe: Explore the city, take it easy, maybe Colca Canyon.
Cusco and Machu Picchu, with some time to chill.

items.note: Either north to Máncora and Vichayito for the beach — or skip the north, stay longer around Cusco and go into the jungle from there.
